title: Angles of elevation & depression
sentences: An angle of elevation looks upward from horizontal; an angle of depression looks downward.
For a level-ground model, the vertical rise divided by the horizontal distance is tangent of the angle.
The rise begins at the observer's eye level, so add eye height to get total height above the ground.
You stand 12 m from a pole.
Its top is at 45° elevation, and your eyes are 1.5 m above level ground.
The pole is 13.5 m tall, assuming the ground between you and the pole is level.
